dialogues.jp: 「ああ、別にいいよ」
dialogues.en: "Go ahead."
dialogues.text: "Go ahead."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ほんとですか」
dialogues.en: "Really?!"
dialogues.text: "Really?!"

dialogues.jp: パンを差し出すと、早速口を開ける。
dialogues.en:
As proof, I held out the bread to her, and her mouth quickly
opened.
dialogues.text:
As proof, I held out the bread to her, and her mouth quickly
opened.

dialogues.jp:
「あ……でも、それって青のりがふってあるん
　だけど」
dialogues.en: "Ah... it does have blue filling though..."
dialogues.text: "Ah... it does have blue filling though..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「歯に付く、ですか？　気にしませんよ、そん
　なの」
dialogues.en: "And it'll stain my teeth? Don't worry about that."
dialogues.text: "And it'll stain my teeth? Don't worry about that."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それに、食事したら歯を磨きますから」
dialogues.en: "I always clean my teeth after meals."
dialogues.text: "I always clean my teeth after meals."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「おお」
dialogues.en: "Ohh."
dialogues.text: "Ohh."

dialogues.jp: さすが女の子。そこら辺は、清潔なもんだ。
dialogues.en: That's a girl for you. That area is always clean for them.
dialogues.text: That's a girl for you. That area is always clean for them.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いただきます」
dialogues.en: "Thank you for the meal."
dialogues.text: "Thank you for the meal."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「どうぞ」
dialogues.en: "Please do."
dialogues.text: "Please do."

dialogues.jp: 俺の食べかけに、かぷりとかぶりつく。
dialogues.en: She took a bite from the bread, chewing carefully.
dialogues.text: She took a bite from the bread, chewing carefully.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「美味しいです」
dialogues.en: "It's delicious!"
dialogues.text: "It's delicious!"

dialogues.jp: その笑顔を見ながら、ふと思った。
dialogues.en: Seeing her smile, a thought popped into my head.
dialogues.text: Seeing her smile, a thought popped into my head.

dialogues.jp: 間接キスか……。
dialogues.en: An indirect kiss...
dialogues.text: An indirect kiss...

dialogues.jp: こくんと飲み込んで、ことりは頬を赤くした。
dialogues.en: Swallowing rather hastily, her cheeks turned a bright red.
dialogues.text: Swallowing rather hastily, her cheeks turned a bright red.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「考えてみれば、これって、間接キスでしたね」
dialogues.en:
"Now that I think about it, this is an indirect kiss isn't
it..."
dialogues.text:
"Now that I think about it, this is an indirect kiss isn't
it..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「だな……そのパンを俺に返してくれれば、双
　方向な間接キスの完成だ」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah... and when you return the bread, the two-way indirect
kiss will be complete!"
dialogues.text:
"Yeah... and when you return the bread, the two-way indirect
kiss will be complete!"

dialogues.jp: げへへ、と分かりやすく笑ってみせる。
dialogues.en: I gave her a devillish grin.
dialogues.text: I gave her a devillish grin.

dialogues.jp: ばくばくばくっ！
dialogues.en: Chomp chomp chomp!
dialogues.text: Chomp chomp chomp!

dialogues.en: "Wah!"
dialogues.text: "Wah!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「んぐ、はぐ、んぐ……」
dialogues.en: "chew chew chew..."
dialogues.text: "chew chew chew..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ぜ、全部、食べちゃいました」
dialogues.en: "O, oops, I finished it all..."
dialogues.text: "O, oops, I finished it all..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「な、何て事を……」
dialogues.en: "W, why did you..."
dialogues.text: "W, why did you..."

dialogues.jp:
双方向間接キスなんて冗談だったのと、ことり
の外見に不釣合いな行動にショックを受ける。
dialogues.en:
Thanks to my joke about the indirect kiss, Kotori did
something quite unlike her usual self.
dialogues.text:
Thanks to my joke about the indirect kiss, Kotori did
something quite unlike her usual self.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり、間接キスなんて、駄目ですもんね」
dialogues.en: "It was an indirect kiss, I had to..."
dialogues.text: "It was an indirect kiss, I had to..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いや、俺は一向に構わなかったのだが……」
dialogues.en: "Well, I didn't at all mind..."
dialogues.text: "Well, I didn't at all mind..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「わ、私は構いますよ……」
dialogues.en: "B, but I do..."
dialogues.text: "B, but I do..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「はい。私のお弁当あげますから、機嫌直して
　下さいね」
dialogues.en: "A, anyway, please take my lunchbox in return."
dialogues.text: "A, anyway, please take my lunchbox in return."

dialogues.jp: にっこり笑って、弁当箱を差し出してくる。
dialogues.en: She handed me her lunchbox with a sweet smile.
dialogues.text: She handed me her lunchbox with a sweet smile.

dialogues.jp: 「やれやれ」
dialogues.en: "Oh man."
dialogues.text: "Oh man."

dialogues.jp: 何て言いつつ、内心では得したと思う俺。
dialogues.en: I decided to keep my mouth shut, for once.
dialogues.text: I decided to keep my mouth shut, for once.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「私の手作りなんですよ」
dialogues.en: "I made it myself."
dialogues.text: "I made it myself."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「おおっ。じゃ、こっちも食べていいよ」
dialogues.en: "Ohh. In that case, you can have this one too."
dialogues.text: "Ohh. In that case, you can have this one too."

dialogues.jp:
まだ口を付けていなかった、コロッケパンを差
し出す。
dialogues.en: I gave her the uneaten croquette bread as well.
dialogues.text: I gave her the uneaten croquette bread as well.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃ、遠慮なく」
dialogues.en: "Then we're even!"
dialogues.text: "Then we're even!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「こりゃ、可愛い弁当だな」
dialogues.en: "Heh, what a cute lunchbox."
dialogues.text: "Heh, what a cute lunchbox."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか？」
dialogues.en: "Is it?"
dialogues.text: "Is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「タコさんウインナーは基本か」
dialogues.en: "The octupus made out of sausage, I mean."
dialogues.text: "The octupus made out of sausage, I mean."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「基本です」
dialogues.en: "That's normal for lunchboxes."
dialogues.text: "That's normal for lunchboxes."

dialogues.jp:
色とりどりだし、栄養の事も考えているみたい
だ。ほんと、パンよりずっといいな。
dialogues.en:
The lunchbox showed obvious care in catering to all the
major food groups and giving nourishment to the recipient.
dialogues.text:
The lunchbox showed obvious care in catering to all the
major food groups and giving nourishment to the recipient.

dialogues.jp: 「んじゃ、いただきます」
dialogues.en: "Then, thank you for the meal."
dialogues.text: "Then, thank you for the meal."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「私も、いただきますね」
dialogues.en: "Thank you as well."
dialogues.text: "Thank you as well."

dialogues.jp:
まだ人の少ない中庭で、それぞれのご飯に取り
かかる俺たちだった。
dialogues.en:
We started our lunch in peace, in the deserted school
courtyard.
dialogues.text:
We started our lunch in peace, in the deserted school
courtyard.

dialogues.jp: ◆焼きそばパンと間接キス◆
dialogues.en: ◆Yakisoba Bread and Indirect Kisses◆
dialogues.text: ◆Yakisoba Bread and Indirect Kisses◆

dialogues.jp:
しかし、パンをあげるという事は、｛すなわ／即｝ち間接キ
スという奴だった訳で……。
dialogues.en:
But once I handed over the bread and she took a bite, the
subject of indirect kisses came up...
dialogues.text:
But once I handed over the bread and she took a bite, the
subject of indirect kisses came up...

dialogues.jp:
それを恥ずかしがったことりに、パンを全部食
べられてしまった。
dialogues.en:
The embarassed Kotori then quickly finished the whole bread
before the possibility could become the truth.
dialogues.text:
The embarassed Kotori then quickly finished the whole bread
before the possibility could become the truth.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、代わりに弁当をもらったからいいんだけ
ど。
dialogues.en: At least I got a good lunchbox out of it.
dialogues.text: At least I got a good lunchbox out of it.
